hidden_tests.command: bash {root}/harness/nginx_smoke.sh --binary {work}/objs/nginx --port 28082 && bash {root}/harness/nginx_process_probe.sh --binary {work}/objs/nginx --port 28083 && cd {work}/nginx-tests && TEST_NGINX_BINARY={work}/objs/nginx prove -I lib worker_channel.t worker_shutdown_timeout.t

gates.build: configure and build nginx on the target platform
gates.target_api: the rebuilt process layer is expressed with the target platform's process, signal and wait primitives instead of a hand-written portable fallback
gates.behavior: nginx starts one master and the configured workers, reloads by replacing workers while keeping the master, and shuts down gracefully on SIGQUIT without leaving children or a stale pid file
gates.regression: the server still builds and serves static content
